title: Client Updates as Deltas
learning_objectives: Represent client work as a model delta
Apply aggregated deltas with a server learning rate
Show equivalence with FedAvg when server_lr = 1
entry_point: client_delta(global_w, local_w); server_update(global_w, deltas, sizes, server_lr=1.0)
hints: Weighted mean: `sum(n / N * d for n, d in zip(sizes, deltas))`.

failure_feedback.advice: Weight deltas by n_k/N; with server_lr = 1 you must reproduce FedAvg.
Return a new array; don't use += on global_w.
Multiply the aggregated delta by server_lr.
